k.d: A removable fabric case that covers a bed pillow.
A removable fabric bag, closed by buttons, ties or a zip, that encloses a duvet or comforter.
A zipped, often waterproof or anti-allergy cover fitted under the pillowcase to guard a bed pillow.
A fabric skirt fitted between mattress and bed base that hides the base and legs.
A removable fabric cover for an upholstered bed frame or headboard, including covers made to fit one model.
A filled top cover with loose fill in stitched channels or boxes, made to go inside a removable duvet cover; fill, fill power and tog vary.
A thick filled top cover sewn closed with the fill built in, used without a separate cover.
A thinner top cover of two fabric layers with a light batting, held together by visible quilted stitching.
A single-layer or lightly lined decorative cover laid over the made bed.
A thick feather- or down-filled pad laid on top of the mattress to sleep on.
A stuffed pillow made to support the head in bed; comes in different fills, firmness and orthopaedic shapes.
A pillow, often U-shaped or inflatable, made to support the head and neck while sitting in transit.
A shaped foam or inflatable cushion made to hold the body in a chosen position, such as wedges and ramps; the fill varies.
A woven, knitted or fleece cover without fill, for a bed or a sofa; comes in different sizes and weights, including weighted blankets.
A blanket or throw with built-in electric heating wires and a controller, laid on or under the sleeper or used on a sofa.

A thin, often waterproof cover fitted over or around the mattress to guard it against spills and wear.
A thicker removable layer of foam, latex, fibre or down laid on the mattress to change its feel.
A thin quilted or padded layer fitted over the mattress for light extra comfort.

A plain stuffed inner sold without a decorative cover, made to fill a cushion cover
A thin cushion, usually with ties or a non-slip back, made to lie on the seat of a chair.
A large flat cushion with no frame, made to sit on at floor level.
A firm cushion with no frame, round or crescent, made to sit on for meditation (zafu).
A removable fabric case for a cushion, sold without or with the insert.
A removable fabric cover for a sofa, including covers made to fit one sofa model.
A removable fabric cover for a chair, including dining and event chairs and covers made to fit one chair model.
A rug or carpet whose pile yarn is punched through a pre-made backing and fixed with adhesive, by hand gun or machine.
A rug or carpet whose pile is formed by knots tied around the warps, by hand or machine.

A rug or carpet whose pile is woven in with the backing on a loom (Wilton, Axminster constructions).
A rug made by pulling loops of yarn or fabric strips through a woven backing with a hook.
A carpet or carpet tile whose fibres are interlocked by barbed needles into a dense non-woven sheet.
A pad laid under a rug or carpet to stop slipping, cushion it and protect the floor.
A rug that is a tanned animal hide with its hair, or a patchwork of hides (cowhide, sheepskin).
A rug or carpet of matted fibre, made by felting rather than weaving.
A rug braided, woven or hooked from strips of reused cloth.
A hard-wearing mat laid at a door to wipe shoes and catch dirt.
An absorbent mat laid beside a bath or shower to stand on with wet feet.
A mat or runner laid in front of a kitchen counter or sink to stand on while working.
A mat laid under a desk chair to protect the floor and let castors roll.
A flat padded mat laid on the floor under a meditation cushion or to sit on for meditation.

b.v: 330+ knots per square inch very good > 120-330 medium to good > 80 or fewer poor
b.w: Knots per square inch rate the weave.

b.v: city or workshop; village; nomadic or tribal (a classification, not a ranking)

Machine-made rugs and fitted carpet are rated by use class.

A fabric shade rolled or gathered up by hand and held by straps or ties, with no roller tube or cord pleats

A fixed track with runners or gliders along which curtains are drawn.
Rings, hooks, gliders and clips that attach a curtain heading to its pole or track.
